Statement of LEUNG Ping Kay

1. | am_LEUNG Ping Kay, Biyecers old, holder of Hong Kong Identity Card No.:
ED 5 于于守于于天芽弄天天加
HRS.) 2014, | joined China Status Development and Engineering
Company Limited (“China Status”) as a director and have been a director of
China Status till this date.

2. Unless otherwise specified, all abbreviations and question numbers referred to
in this statement are based on references in the letter by Messrs. Lo & Lo, and |
now make this statement as directed by the Independent Committee.

Question 1

3. In or around March 2025, | received a telephone call from Mr. Gordon Ho (I do
not know his full name) of Prestige Constructions & Engineering Co., Limited
("PC&E"), requesting a quote from China Status for submitting fire service
installations Shutdown Notice(s) ("SDN(s)") to the Fire Services Department
("FSD") for the temporary shutdown of the fire hydrant or hose reel system
("FH/HR System") of 8 buildings in Wang Fuk Court, so that PC&E could carry out
renovation works to the fire services water tanks of these 8 buildings.

4. On or around 25" March 2025, | prepared and provided a quote on behalf of China
Status to PC&E as requested. This quote covers 3 items of work / services:

i. Procurement of 128 9-Litre fire extinguishers.
ii. Submission of SDNs to the FSD; and
iii. Issuance of Form FS251s.

5. Several days later, | was informed by Mr. Cheung of PC&E (I also do not know his
full name) over the telephone that PC&E would be engaging China Status as
outlined in our quotation of 25" March 2025.

6. On or around 28" March 2025, we received from PC&E our quotation with their
company chop, signifying parties formally entering into a contract. On the same
day, | prepared and issued on behalf of China Status to PC&E an invoice for 50%
of the contract price as deposit.
